internal.title: Incident Summary: High Latency in Ad Service Due to CPU Exhaustion
internal.body:
On 2026-11-08 at 10:16 UTC, an alert was triggered for high latency in the ad service. Investigation revealed that the service was experiencing resource exhaustion, specifically very high CPU utilization at 98%, which caused the p95 latency to spike to 1.8 seconds. The error rate remained low, indicating the service was slow but not failing outright. The root cause was identified as a recent flag change that enabled 'adHighCpu', leading to CPU saturation.

The mitigation involved disabling the 'adHighCpu' flag at 10:36 UTC, which was approved and executed promptly. Post-mitigation monitoring confirmed recovery with latency returning to normal levels (p95 latency reduced to 0.12 seconds).

This incident highlights the impact of configuration changes on service performance and the importance of monitoring resource utilization closely.

Timeline:
- 10:16 UTC: Alert received for high latency
- 10:36 UTC: Diagnosis confirmed CPU exhaustion due to flag change
- 10:36 UTC: Flag disabled
- 10:36 UTC: Recovery verified

Severity: SEV2
